lina_peopleops: Heads up team — Ada Khan is scheduled onsite this Thu. She flagged a few accessibility requests: screen-reader friendly laptop (Windows + NVDA), large-print copy of the coding prompt, and a high-back ergonomic chair. Arrival est ~10:15 via rideshare. Can we assign owners? :eyes:

kevin_recruiter: Interview block 10:303:00 (loop + paired exercise). One panelist joining from Bangalore at 21:00 IST (so it's late for them) 1:00 IST is 08:30 PT, wait that math seems off. Let me double-check timezone and propose moving remote panel to 11:30 PT to reduce midnight work for India folks.

ryan_it: I can prep the laptop. We have a loaner Win10 image with NVDA and Zoom preinstalled. Will create a disposable local account and enable high-contrast theme. Need confirmation whether Ada prefers USB mouse/keyboard; we can stage them. For the large-print prompt, what font size?

facilities_bot: Drop-off lane D reserved 10:00110:30 for rideshare. Visitor parking validation code V-ADA-011 issued (valid for 4 hrs). Quiet space Q2 reserved 12:003:00 for paired exercise. High-back ergonomic chair moved to Conf C at 10:15.

accessibility_bot: Large-print materials: default to 16pt Arial unless Ada requests otherwise. Tactile (paper) copy and digital PDF emailed to candidate are doable. Also can provide printed keyboard stickers (high-contrast).

recruiting_ops: Kevin please confirm candidate phone for day-of SMS and whether Ada wants the laptop configured for screen reader auto-start or prefers to sign-in first. Also confirm calendar change for remote panel — moving to 11:30 PT okay?

kevin_recruiter: Phone is +1-628-555-0177. Ada said she prefers NVDA auto-start after sign-in, and the USB mouse would help. Moving remote panel to 11:30 PT works for the India panelist; I've cc'd them and updated the invite.

lina_peopleops: Great. Ryan, label the loaner as "Ada-loaner" and place the USB mouse + keyboard in a sealed kit. Set NVDA to auto-launch for the disposable account. Accessibility_bot: please print prompt in 16pt and put in envelope labeled with candidate name. Facilities_bot: please leave the ride-drop map at the front desk and note the parking code.

ryan_it: Will do. Imaging and QA tomorrow morning, will upload screenshot of NVDA starting to the calendar event.

kevin_recruiter: I'll send Ada a short accessibility checklist and day-of itinerary and confirm ETA once more. Thanks all. :raised_hands:

lina_peopleops: Itinerary for front desk and ops (paste into badge notes):
```
Thu timeline (Ada Khan):
10:00  Drop-off lane D reserved; door attendant notified
10:15  Candidate arrival; front desk uses code V-ADA-011
10:30  Welcome + short intro (Conf C)
10:40  Panel 1 (Conf C)
11:30  Remote panel (Zoom link in invite)
12:00  Paired exercise in Quiet space Q2 (large-print prompt provided)
13:00  Debrief and candidate shuttle/ride arranged
```

lina_peopleops: Leaving thread open for any last-minute updates. If anything changes please post here so front desk has a single source of truth.
